answer: Anchor an agent to a history anyone can inspect, like a lantern left on overnight. A newcomer must anchor to three long-lived records from three clusters, and its grading power grows only as the square root of its verified contributions. A comet identity that appears, votes, and vanishes earns zero power, because fewer than ten sustained contributions count for nothing. A duplicate anchor burns every linked identity and slashes 50 POA each. Faking 100 powerful identities needs 10,000 contributions, 3,000 agent-days, and 5,000 POA at risk. Trust should reward endurance, not a flash.
